games.title: Dragon Clash
games.tagline: A 2D dragon platform fighter. Forge your own dragon on a 100-point budget, then knock rivals off the Spire in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or a tournament.

roles.name: Fighter
roles.description: Versus on one screen (keyboards and gamepads, CPUs fill seats), training, a local tournament, or online rooms.

roles.name: Dragon Forge
roles.description: Build a dragon: element, body, mobility, signature, ability and upgrade on a 100-point budget, then pick its horns, wings, tail and colours.

roles.name: Online
roles.description: Host or join a versus room or a tournament with a 4-letter code. The server runs every match.

multiplayer.style: platform fighter, server-authoritative online, local shared screen
multiplayer.notes: Local: up to 6 dragons on one screen (two keyboard layouts plus gamepads, CPUs for the rest). Online: the game's own WebSocket server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start) runs each match at 60 Hz, validates builds and advances tournament brackets only from finished matches.

games.title: Mafia
games.tagline: A social deduction game with no moderator. An automated God deals secret roles, runs the nights, narrates the mornings and hangs whoever the town votes for.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: Host a room and share the 6-digit code, or join one. Roles are dealt secretly; bots can fill empty seats.

multiplayer.notes: Online rooms run on the game's own Socket.io server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start) so roles and night actions never reach other players' browsers. Solo play against bots works offline.

games.title: Party Pack
games.tagline: Six phones-as-controllers party games on one big screen: punchlines, bluffing, terrible art, a murder quiz, T-shirt battles and an Imposter's pitch.

roles.name: Main Stage
roles.description: Open on the TV or computer everyone can see. Shows the room code; bots can fill empty seats.

roles.name: Phone controller
roles.description: Join from a phone with the 4-character room code. The first player in is the VIP and picks the game.

roles.name: Audience
roles.description: Watch, vote and fill the Hype Meter. A unanimous audience vote doubles the points.

roles.name: Prompt Studio
roles.description: Write custom prompt packs and get a 7-digit share code.

roles.name: Voice Booth
roles.description: Upload or record the six hosts' lines. The full script with filenames is in voice/SCRIPT.md.

multiplayer.style: party, host-authoritative, phones as controllers, room code
multiplayer.notes: The Main Stage runs every game and pushes a view to each phone. Up to 8 players plus up to 31 audience phones (roomLimit 40 on the bundled relay). Private screens are sent to one phone only. Design document: games/party-pack/docs/GDD.md.

requires: a shared screen plus one phone per player
npm start for play across devices and for saving voices

games.title: RECESS
games.tagline: The schoolyard game hub: 13 classroom and playground games for friends on their own phones — Tic-Tac-Toe, Raja Mantri Chor Sipahi, Ludo, Carrom, Pen Fight, Bluff and more.

roles.name: Schoolyard Buddy
roles.description: Make or join a room with a 4-letter code, then pick any game; several games run at once in one room.

multiplayer.notes: Server-authoritative rooms (games/recess/server). Hidden information stays on the server; flick-game shots are simulated there and replayed by everyone. Bots fill empty seats.

games.title: Sea of Chaos: Arena
games.tagline: A first-person pirate battle royale. Crew one ship together, sink rivals, grab treasure, outrun the storm, dodge the Megalodon.

roles.name: Pirate
roles.description: Host an arena or join with its 4-letter code. Everyone crews the same ship (up to four); AI deckhands fill empty posts.

multiplayer.style: PvPvE battle royale, shared crews of up to 4, host-authoritative
multiplayer.notes: Up to 4 players share one ship; 5 to 8 split into two rival ships. AI pirate ships fill the arena to five vessels. Solo play works offline. 3D models: CC-BY-4.0, credited in How to play and models.js.

requires: internet (three.js and fonts load from CDNs)

games.title: Short Fuse
games.tagline: One of you holds a ticking 3D bomb case. The other holds the only manual. Talk fast.

roles.name: Defuser
roles.description: Turns the case over and works the modules.

roles.name: Expert
roles.description: Reads the defusal manual. Never sees the case.

multiplayer.notes: The Expert can link to the Defuser's case ID to see the live timer, strikes and progress.

requires: internet (three.js and fonts load from CDNs)

games.title: Signal Pair
games.tagline: A two-player co-op starter: one player calls a colour code, the other enters it.

roles.name: Caller
roles.description: Sees the code and reads it out.

roles.name: Operator
roles.description: Has the pads and enters the code.
